FINAL IVX MODULE LOADING + MEDIA UPLOAD + REELS STABILITY QA
INSTAGRAM-STYLE PERFORMANCE — EXECUTE END TO END

PRIORITY: P0 MOBILE STABILITY
SCOPE: EVERY MODULE, CARD, IMAGE, VIDEO, UPLOAD AND REELS PLAYER

Do not redesign the application.
Do not change the approved layout.
Do not return an audit-only report.

The objective is:

1. No blank screens.
2. No unnecessary full-page loading indicators.
3. Cached content appears immediately.
4. Data refreshes quietly in the background.
5. Upload progress survives navigation and app restart.
6. Reels upload reliably.
7. Reels do not crash after several seconds or repeated swipes.
8. One media failure does not crash the feed.
9. Every module uses one standardized loading/error/cache system.
10. Physical Android testing proves stability.

“Instagram-style” means perceived-performance and media-lifecycle techniques.
Do not claim access to Instagram proprietary code.

==================================================
1. COMPLETE MODULE INVENTORY
==================================================

Find every data-driven module and screen, including:

- Home
- Landing feed
- Investment cards
- Deal details
- Reels
- Posts
- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- JV Deals
- Tokenized
- Properties
- Messages
- Notifications
- Owner Dashboard
- Admin Dashboard
- Documents
- Media
- Transactions
- Portfolio
- Autonomous Dashboard
- IVX IA Chat

For every module return:

MODULE:
SCREEN FILE:
QUERY HOOK:
API ROUTE:
DATABASE TABLE:
CACHE KEY:
CURRENT LOADING UI:
CURRENT ERROR UI:
PAGINATION:
REFRESH:
REALTIME:
MEDIA:
KNOWN CRASH:
STATUS:

Identify:

- duplicate query implementations
- full-screen spinners
- sequential API waterfalls
- missing pagination
- uncached queries
- unstable list keys
- duplicate requests
- render loops
- state updates after unmount
- memory leaks
- missing cancellation
- oversized payloads
- unbounded realtime subscriptions

==================================================
2. ONE STANDARD DATA-LAYER ARCHITECTURE
==================================================

Use one canonical query/cache system for all modules.

Required behavior:

INITIAL OPEN:
CACHE → immediate UI

BACKGROUND:
CACHE → API revalidation → silent update

NO CACHE:
SKELETON → API → content

FAILURE WITH CACHE:
SHOW CACHED CONTENT + small retry banner

FAILURE WITHOUT CACHE:
INLINE ERROR STATE + retry

Do not replace valid cached content with a full-page spinner.

Standardize:

- query keys
- stale time
- garbage-collection time
- retries
- timeout
- cancellation
- pagination
- optimistic updates
- offline behavior
- focus/reconnect refetch
- background refresh
- error normalization

No component may create a new query client.

==================================================
3. REMOVE BAD LOADING EXPERIENCES
==================================================

Find and replace:

- blank screens
- infinite spinners
- full-page “Loading...” screens
- layout jumping
- cards appearing one by one with shifting heights
- repeated loading on tab changes
- loading when returning to a previously visited screen
- disappearing data during refresh

Use:

- stable skeleton cards
- cached content
- shimmer only where appropriate
- reserved media aspect ratio
- inline progress indicators
- pull-to-refresh
- stale-data indicator only when useful
- retry banner with trace ID

Skeleton dimensions must match final content dimensions.

==================================================
4. PREFETCHING STRATEGY
==================================================

Prefetch before the user reaches content.

When Home opens:

- load first visible cards
- prefetch next page metadata
- prefetch first image of the next cards
- preload poster images
- do not preload every full-resolution asset

When user approaches a Reel:

- prefetch poster
- preload the video manifest/initial segment
- prepare the next 1–2 Reels
- release videos far outside the viewport

When user taps View Deal:

- use already cached deal data immediately
- fetch additional details in background

Avoid over-prefetching that increases memory usage or data consumption.

==================================================
5. IMAGE PIPELINE
==================================================

Audit every image source.

Required:

- optimized storage variants
- thumbnail
- medium
- full resolution
- stable aspect ratio
- cache key/version
- CDN URL
- content type
- width/height metadata
- blurhash or approved placeholder
- progressive transition
- retry
- fallback
- broken-image state

Do not load original 4K/8K images into small cards.

Recommended delivery:

FEED:
thumbnail or medium

DETAIL:
medium, then full when opened

ZOOM:
full resolution on demand

Prevent mixed project images by requiring:

deal_id
media_id
sort_order
version

Never associate media by project title.

==================================================
6. LIST PERFORMANCE
==================================================

Audit every FlatList/FlashList/virtualized list.

Required:

- stable unique keys
- memoized rows
- stable callbacks
- estimated item size where applicable
- pagination
- controlled render window
- clipping only when safe
- no nested uncontrolled vertical lists
- no index used as the permanent key
- no full feed rerender after like/comment
- no array recreation causing all cards to rerender

Measure:

INITIAL RENDER:
SCROLL FPS:
DROPPED FRAMES:
MEMORY START:
MEMORY AFTER 10 MINUTES:
RENDER COUNT PER CARD:

==================================================
7. CANONICAL MEDIA UPLOAD SERVICE
==================================================

Create one shared upload service for:

- post images
- post videos
- Reels
- deal media
- profile pictures
- documents
- message attachments

Required pipeline:

SELECT FILE
→ VALIDATE
→ CREATE LOCAL DRAFT
→ COMPRESS/TRANSCODE
→ REQUEST UPLOAD SESSION
→ UPLOAD
→ VERIFY CHECKSUM
→ CREATE DATABASE MEDIA RECORD
→ PROCESS SERVER-SIDE
→ GENERATE THUMBNAIL/POSTER
→ MARK READY
→ PUBLISH
→ INVALIDATE CACHE
→ SYNC FEED

Required upload states:

DRAFT
VALIDATING
COMPRESSING
QUEUED
UPLOADING
PAUSED
PROCESSING
READY
PUBLISHING
PUBLISHED
FAILED
CANCELLED

Never show unprocessed media as published.

==================================================
8. RESUMABLE AND RELIABLE UPLOADS
==================================================

Implement:

- multipart or resumable upload for large video
- retry with backoff
- network-change recovery
- upload cancellation
- persistent local upload queue
- idempotency key
- duplicate-file prevention
- checksum verification
- signed URL expiration recovery
- background continuation where platform permits
- resume after app restart
- server reconciliation

The user must see:

FILE:
PROGRESS:
CURRENT STAGE:
RETRY:
CANCEL:
ERROR:
TRACE ID:

Do not hold the entire video file in JavaScript memory.

==================================================
9. FILE VALIDATION
==================================================

Validate before upload:

- MIME type
- extension
- real media metadata
- file size
- duration
- dimensions
- codec
- orientation
- corrupted file
- unsupported container
- zero-byte file

Reject safely with a user-friendly reason.

Do not trust file extension alone.

==================================================
10. REELS VIDEO NORMALIZATION
==================================================

Normalize uploaded Reels into a known playback format.

Create server-side processing for:

- orientation correction
- metadata normalization
- poster generation
- thumbnail generation
- audio normalization
- fast-start metadata
- adaptive bitrate output where supported
- mobile-compatible video codec
- mobile-compatible audio codec
- consistent frame-rate policy
- duration validation

Prefer adaptive streaming for production Reels where infrastructure supports it.

Maintain:

original_media_id
processed_media_id
poster_media_id
processing_status
processing_error
duration
width
height
aspect_ratio
codec
bitrate
version

Do not publish until playback validation passes.

==================================================
11. REELS CRASH ROOT-CAUSE AUDIT
==================================================

Instrument the crash before patching blindly.

Capture:

- device model
- Android/iOS version
- app version
- Git SHA
- active Reel ID
- video URL
- codec
- duration
- player count
- memory usage
- JS errors
- native errors
- decoder error
- network status
- app foreground/background
- time since feed opened
- number of swipes
- trace ID

Audit common causes:

- too many mounted video players
- multiple players playing simultaneously
- players not released on unmount
- listener/subscription leaks
- unstable Reel keys
- player recreated on every render
- state update after unmount
- unsupported video codec
- corrupted media
- oversized video
- expired signed URL
- repeated source replacement
- duplicate realtime events
- feed page duplication
- navigation focus bug
- Android decoder exhaustion
- memory pressure
- unhandled playback promise/error
- background/foreground lifecycle failure

Return the exact confirmed root cause or ranked evidence-based causes.

==================================================
12. ACTIVE REEL PLAYER MANAGEMENT
==================================================

Implement a centralized Reel playback coordinator.

Rules:

- exactly one Reel plays at a time
- next Reel may be prepared/preloaded
- previous Reel pauses immediately
- far off-screen players are released
- tab/navigation blur pauses all playback
- app background pauses and releases appropriately
- audio focus is handled correctly
- interrupted playback recovers safely
- failed Reel skips without crashing feed

Recommended active window:

CURRENT:
mounted and playing

PREVIOUS/NEXT:
prepared or lightweight

ALL OTHERS:
poster only, player released

Do not keep every video player mounted.

==================================================
13. VISIBILITY AND FOCUS LOGIC
==================================================

Playback may start only when:

- screen is focused
- app is active
- Reel meets visibility threshold
- Reel is selected as canonical active item
- media status is READY
- source URL is valid

Use one visibility callback and one active Reel ID.

Prevent competing callbacks from starting multiple videos.

==================================================
14. PLAYER LIFECYCLE
==================================================

For every player verify:

CREATE
PREPARE
PLAY
PAUSE
SEEK
END
ERROR
UNLOAD/RELEASE

On component removal:

- remove listeners
- stop progress timers
- abort pending source loads
- release player
- clear references

Do not call state setters after unmount.

Use error boundaries so one broken Reel cannot crash the complete screen.

==================================================
15. REELS DATA PAGINATION
==================================================

Required:

- cursor-based pagination
- stable sort
- unique Reel ID
- deduplication between pages
- no overlapping page fetch
- end-of-list detection
- prefetch next page
- refresh reconciliation
- realtime event deduplication

Canonical ordering:

published_at DESC
stable_reel_id DESC

or another documented deterministic rule.

Do not use array index as Reel identity.

==================================================
16. REELS ERROR UX
==================================================

On video failure:

- keep poster visible
- show “Video unavailable”
- provide Retry
- provide Skip
- log trace ID
- continue feed operation

Never:

- show an endless black player
- freeze navigation
- crash the application
- repeatedly reload indefinitely
- play audio from an invisible Reel

==================================================
17. POST CARD AND INVESTMENT CARD MEDIA
==================================================

Audit Post cards and Investment cards using the same media service.

Test:

- image carousel
- video preview
- mixed image/video post
- first-frame poster
- swipe behavior
- autoplay disabled where appropriate
- full-screen viewer
- return to exact scroll position
- like/comment updates without feed reload
- share
- save
- deleted media
- private media
- expired media URL

All cards for the same deal must reference the same canonical media IDs.

==================================================
18. MODULE-BY-MODULE LOADING QA
==================================================

For every module test:

FIRST OPEN:
No cache

SECOND OPEN:
Warm cache

RETURN FROM ANOTHER TAB:
Must appear instantly

PULL TO REFRESH:
Existing content remains visible

OFFLINE:
Cached content remains visible

SLOW NETWORK:
Skeleton or cached content, no blank screen

HTTP 401:
Session recovery or login

HTTP 403:
Access denied state

HTTP 404:
Not-found state

HTTP 409:
Conflict handling

HTTP 429:
Backoff and clear message

HTTP 500/502/503:
Retry without duplicate actions

EMPTY DATA:
Real empty state, not loading forever

==================================================
19. NO-FAKE-DATA RULE
==================================================

Remove production mock/fallback records.

Every displayed:

- member
- investor
- buyer
- project
- deal
- Reel
- post
- transaction
- notification

must come from a verified API/database source.

Development fixtures must be impossible to activate in production.

==================================================
20. CACHE INVALIDATION
==================================================

Define explicit invalidation after:

- new post
- new Reel
- media processing complete
- like/unlike
- comment
- save
- Admin deal update
- media reorder
- media delete
- deal publish
- account/role change

Do not invalidate the entire application unnecessarily.

Update the smallest relevant cache scope.

==================================================
21. REALTIME SUBSCRIPTION SAFETY
==================================================

Audit all Supabase realtime subscriptions.

Required:

- one subscription per intended channel
- cleanup on screen unmount
- no duplicate listeners after navigation
- event deduplication
- stable reconciliation
- backfill after reconnect
- no full-query refresh for every minor event
- reconnect status
- bounded retry

Measure active subscriptions after:

- first open
- 10 tab switches
- app background/foreground
- logout/login

They must not continually increase.

==================================================
22. NETWORK AND API OPTIMIZATION
==================================================

Audit:

- N+1 queries
- repeated profile lookups
- repeated signed URL creation
- oversized JSON
- uncompressed responses
- sequential calls
- missing indexes
- missing filters
- unbounded result sets

Create feed APIs returning only fields required for cards.

Load full detail only on demand.

Return API performance:

P50
P95
P99
PAYLOAD SIZE
DB TIME
TOTAL TIME
CACHE HIT/MISS

==================================================
23. CRASH CONTAINMENT
==================================================

Add boundaries around:

- Reels screen
- individual Reel
- Post card
- Investment card
- media uploader
- full-screen viewer

A component error must show a recoverable local fallback, not crash the app.

Integrate production crash reporting if already approved/configured.

Return:

CRASH ID
APP VERSION
GIT SHA
SCREEN
MEDIA ID
USER ACTION
STACK
NATIVE STACK
MEMORY
TRACE ID

Do not expose personal data or secrets.

==================================================
24. PHYSICAL ANDROID SOAK TEST
==================================================

Install the newest production APK on a real Android phone.

Execute:

- open Home for 15 minutes
- scroll 200 investment/post cards
- open/close 30 deal details
- swipe at least 100 Reels
- leave Reels playing for 15 minutes
- background/foreground app 20 times
- rotate if supported
- switch Wi-Fi/cellular
- disable network and restore it
- upload 10 images
- upload 5 videos
- cancel one upload
- resume one interrupted upload
- restart during an upload
- like/comment/save/share repeatedly
- logout/login
- restart app

Record:

CRASHES:
ANRS:
MEMORY START:
MEMORY PEAK:
MEMORY END:
DROPPED FRAMES:
FAILED VIDEOS:
DUPLICATE AUDIO:
UPLOAD FAILURES:
RECOVERY RESULT:

Target:

0 crashes
0 ANRs
0 simultaneous audio
0 lost published uploads
0 infinite loaders

==================================================
25. IOS TESTING
==================================================

When iOS infrastructure is available, repeat:

- Face ID/session restoration
- Reels playback
- background/foreground
- uploads
- memory soak
- audio focus
- network switching

Do not report iOS PASS from Android or simulator results.

==================================================
26. AUTOMATED TESTS
==================================================

Create and run:

- query/cache tests
- pagination tests
- deduplication tests
- media association tests
- upload state-machine tests
- resumable upload tests
- expired signed URL tests
- video processing-status tests
- active-player coordinator tests
- visibility tests
- lifecycle cleanup tests
- error-boundary tests
- network recovery tests
- realtime cleanup tests
- memory regression tests where possible
- API contract tests
- RLS tests
- TypeScript
- lint

No critical tests may be skipped.

==================================================
27. OBSERVABILITY DASHBOARD
==================================================

Create owner-only Media & Performance diagnostics.

Show:

- module loading failures
- API latency
- cache hit ratio
- image failures
- video failures
- upload queue
- failed uploads
- processing failures
- active players
- memory warnings
- crash-free sessions
- Reel start time
- buffering rate
- completion rate
- device/app-version breakdown

Add filters:

DATE
APP VERSION
PLATFORM
MODULE
MEDIA ID
DEAL ID
ERROR CODE

==================================================
28. DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

After fixing:

1. Commit to the canonical owner repository.
2. Return full GitHub SHA.
3. Run automated tests.
4. Deploy backend.
5. Verify GitHub SHA equals runtime SHA.
6. Deploy media-processing service if separate.
7. Deploy landing/web changes.
8. Invalidate CDN only where needed.
9. Rebuild Android APK because mobile player/UI code changed.
10. Increment version code.
11. Return APK URL and SHA-256.
12. Install on physical Android.
13. Run the complete soak test.

FINAL VERDICT:

Do not return VERIFIED unless:

- every module displays cached or skeleton content without blank screens;
- no module remains in infinite loading;
- video uploads complete and survive interruption;
- one failed Reel cannot crash the feed;
- exactly one Reel plays at a time;
- off-screen players are released;
- 100 consecutive Reel swipes pass on physical Android;
- 15-minute Reels soak produces no crash or duplicate audio;
- the current APK contains the tested code;
- GitHub SHA equals production runtime SHA.
